format: HOT3D-Clips webdataset tar (not the full VRS release)
license: HOT3D license agreement (same as the full dataset)
why_clips: Full VRS HOT3D requires an ephemeral download-links JSON from projectaria.com after signup. HOT3D-Clips are the public subset.

layout.train_aria: 8 clips, official train split, Aria RGB stream 214-1, MANO GT in *.hands.json and __hand_shapes.json__
layout.test_aria: 2 clips, official test_ht_pose split. RGB present. hands.json is withheld by the dataset authors.

clip_facts.test_sequence: P0004_1984bf99 (participant P0004, official HOT3D test participant)

train_loader_expects: data/hot3d/train/*.pt shared Clip format. These raw tars are not read by train.py until converted.
